subject: Melmond
text: To reach Earth Cave from Melmond, head west and southwest along the coastline, take the small land bridge south onto a large peninsula, then head south and turn east to the cave mouth.

evidence.quote:
Head off to the west to start, heading southwest along the coast line.  once
you reach a small land bridge leading south, take it to get onto a large
peninsula where your party should go south and then turn east to walk
towards the cave mouth.

subject: Hall Of Giants
text: Going straight left from the start of Earth Cave leads to the Hall Of Giants, where every step triggers a fight with at least one Giant often accompanied by an Iguana.

evidence.quote:
A quick note about this cave, if you go straight to the left from the start,
you will find the legendary "Hall Of Giants", where every step will bring at
least one Giant to fight you each time!  They will often be accompanied by
an Iguana or two.

subject: Earth Cave
text: Following the upwards branch of the first floor of Earth Cave leads to a dead-end room with a treasure chest containing 1975 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
Start off by walking to the upwards branch
of the cave to follow it to the dead-end to find a room where 1975 Gold
Pieces are yours form a Treasure Chest.

subject: Earth
text: Earth has 288 HP, awards 768 Gold and 1536 Exp, cannot be run from, and is weak to Fire spells such as Fir2 and Fir3.

evidence.quote:
H.P.: 288

Gold: 768

Exp.: 1536...That being said, running from them is not an
option, so take them on with everything you got to end the fight quickly.
They do have one weakness, and that is to Fire, so Fir2 and Fir3 will really
damage them badly.

subject: Earth Cave
text: Heading down the right side from the start of Earth Cave and taking the right fork leads down to a room with a Pure Potion in a treasure chest.

evidence.quote:
You will arrive at a fork, so head right and then down to find a
room with two Treasure Chests.  Walk left as soon as you enter the room and
approach the two Treasure Chests from below to avoid the Earth guardian (go
up top if you want to tangle with the Earth Guardian) to get the Pure Potion
and 795 Gold Pieces before returning to the fork.

subject: Earth Cave
text: A room down the right path from the first fork contains a treasure chest holding 795 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
Walk left as soon as you enter the room and
approach the two Treasure Chests from below to avoid the Earth guardian (go
up top if you want to tangle with the Earth Guardian) to get the Pure Potion
and 795 Gold Pieces before returning to the fork.

subject: Earth Cave
text: Heading left from the fork and down the second path leads to a room where the right treasure chest holds a Heal Potion guarded by an Earth.

evidence.quote:
Now head left, ignoring
the first path leading down to take the next path leading down to find a
room that holds two Treasure Chests.  The right one holds a Heal Potion
(grab it form the side or face an Earth), and the left one holds 880 Gold
Pieces.

subject: Earth Cave
text: The left treasure chest in the room down the second southern path holds 880 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
The right one holds a Heal Potion
(grab it form the side or face an Earth), and the left one holds 880 Gold

subject: Earth Cave
text: On the second floor of Earth Cave, navigating through the holes and moving along the left wall of the room yields a Coral Sword.

evidence.quote:
Move through the hole below, go right to the next hole and through it (up),
and then go right to go through the hole below.  Head through the next hole
below, followed by going right through the one choice passages, and then
head right to enter the room.  Here you will walk up the left wall to get a
Coral Sword, then go right one step to get a Cabin, and then go right one
step and down one step to get 330 Gold Pieces before leaving the room.

subject: Earth Cave

evidence.quote:

step and down one step to get 330 Gold Pieces before leaving the room.

subject: Earth Cave

evidence.quote:

subject: Earth Cave
text: Following the path on B3 up, right, and down leads to a room with a Heal Potion in a treasure chest.

evidence.quote:
Now head left

subject: Earth Cave

evidence.quote:
Ignore that room as you start downwards,
take the right path to enter a room, battle the Earth, and then grab the

subject: Vampire
text: The Vampire has 156 HP, awards 2000 Gold and 1200 Exp, uses Dazzle (Stun), and is weak to Harm and Fire spells (such as Fir2, Hrm2, Fir3, and Hrm3).

evidence.quote:
H.P.: 156

Gold: 2000

Exp.: 1200...He brings a decent attack power and his special ability called Dazzle (Stun)
to knock your party down for good!  He is undead, so of course Harm and Fire
spells will clean his clock (one shot of Fir2, Hrm2, Fir3, or Hrm3 are often
enough to knock him down immediately!)!

subject: Earth Cave
text: After defeating the Vampire, a treasure chest holds the RUBY.

evidence.quote:
Go up and grab the RUBY from the Treasure Chest, which is what you will need
soon enough!

subject: Metal Plate

subject: Melmond
text: Head west across the marshy expanse, continuing west instead of turning south to the peninsula, then at the patch of forest head southwest between two mountains through a small forest to enter the Titan's Tunnel.

evidence.quote:
Head west across the marshy expanse, this time continuing west instead of
turning south to the peninsula.  When you hit the patch of forest, head
southwest between two mountains to pass through a small forest on your way
to enter the Titan's Tunnel!
